name: MYTHI-Kilig Romance
source: Mythi-KILIG Romance is a parody Visual Novel Game for Philippine Folklore enthusiasts who wish to see a fresh perspective. Play as Ernesto and enter a world filled with beauties. It features various Philippine Mythical Creatures that are ‘toned down’ to be physically attractive humanoid beings that players will encounter during the game. The game gives a fresh perspective on mythical beings in the Philippines, to put aside the scary and unsettling thoughts of many Filipinos who grew up to be told these stories. This game aims to bring awareness on Philippine Folklore, though the characters will not be traditional, there are various characteristics each Mythical Creature has that are interesting. Mythi-KILIG Romance is a game that wishes people to put aside their fears that hinder them to learn more about Philippine Folklore.
